desc: Define the four diagonal directions and their clockwise successors, carefully verifying the coordinate convention.
Design DP tables or memoized recursion for the maximum alternating continuation from each cell in each direction and expected-value phase.
Determine how to combine a straight prefix with a turned suffix while avoiding double-counting the turn cell.
Prove that checking every `1` as a start and every diagonal direction covers all valid segments, including zero-turn segments.
Implement the `Solution.lenOfVDiagonal` method with O(nm) complexity and compact DP storage.
Run the implementation against all supplied examples and targeted edge cases, then fix any discovered failures.
